product_metadata.title: Silvercloud Trading Co. Natural Wood Dough Bowl, 22" Farmhouse Decorative Display
features: Great as a catch-all Tray or trough.
Great for succulents, florals, wedding centerpieces or other arrangements!
description: Enjoy the rugged and natural beauty that rustic home decor has to offer. This rectangular Unfinished, natural wood dough bowl measures approx 22"long x 7"wide (and 3.5" tall). Color will vary from light to dark including woodgrain and filler. Looks beautiful styled with our succulents and moss! Pick an assortment of succulents, and and tuck in some moss for filling in any gaps and you've got a beautiful year-round arrangement! Great for all Decor. Great as a catch all tray for keys, remotes and cell phones.
